subject: Request: Postpone Customer Testimonial — sensitivity after recent incident
summary: Customer requested a short testimonial. Internal review flagged an operational incident last quarter and recent churn signals; legal and CS recommend postponing publication until metrics/claims are validated. Leadership approved postponement and requested a response to the customer confirming delay.
messages:
From: Sean O'Connell <sean.oconnell@peregrine.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com; cs@peregrine.com
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Quick: Short testimonial and quote request

Hi Vivek —

Thanks again for the help over the pilot. Marketing at Peregrine would love a 2–3 sentence quote and the green light to use our logo in a short customer story on your site and a one-page PDF. Attached is the draft copy (Peregrine_Testimonial_Draft_v2.docx) and a mockup. Happy to review edits.

Would you let me know if you need legal/brand approvals on your side? We can get that over quickly.

Best,
Sean
Sean O'Connell
Head of Partnerships, Peregrine Logistics
sean.oconnell@peregrine.com

--
Attachment: Peregrine_Testimonial_Draft_v2.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick: Short testimonial and quote request

Marissa / Neha — heads up, Peregrine sent the testimonial draft. I skimmed it and it looks fine, except this: last quarter they had a 6-hour routing outage that affected latency for some customers. Marketing will want to highlight uptime improvements but we should check that any uptime claims / ROI numbers get legal/CS sign-off.

I think we should pause publication until legal verifies the language and CS confirms there isn't churn risk from that incident. Can you take point on this? If so, please loop in Peregrine legal if required.

Thanks — Vivek
VP, Business Development
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Quick: Short testimonial — need legal/CS review

Neha / Jonas — forwarding the draft and Vivek's note. Attachments: incident timeline (CS provided), and our redline_suggestions.docx (marketing edits).

Ask: can legal confirm whether the current wording ("99.9% uptime" and "reduced retrieval costs by 40%") is supportable given their incident? CS: please confirm whether Peregrine is still a referenceable customer given recent support tickets and whether publishing a story would cause churn risk.

If legal recommends changes, please propose redlines; Marcom will update. We need an answer by EOD Thursday so we can slot this in the May customer stories run.

Thanks — Marissa
Sr. Product Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: incident_timeline_202603.pdf, redline_suggestions.docx

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 15 Apr 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick: Short testimonial — legal and compliance input

Thanks for the ping. Quick read: the phrase '99.9% uptime' is borderline given the documented outage in March. We should either: 1) remove explicit percentage claims, or 2) add a clarifying parenthetical and a citation to the timeframe that supports the number.

Also: "reduced retrieval costs by 40%" — we need a data source (time-bound) to substantiate that. Marketing can include a qualifying sentence like "customer-reported average retrieval cost reduction in Q1 2026" and we should keep the raw metric in the appendix rather than the headline.

Legal note on referenceability: Peregrine's legal team will want a short reference agreement (one paragraph) and to review the final PDF. Given the recent support tickets (see incident_timeline_202603.pdf), CS recommends we delay public publication by 2–3 weeks to let Peregrine complete their internal postmortem and to ensure they remain comfortable being a public reference.

Recommendation: postpone publication; propose a redlined testimonial that removes hard percentages in the headline and moves quant metrics to an appendix / footnote. I've attached suggested redlines.

-Neha
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

> On Mon, Apr 13, 2026 at 08:30 AM Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> > Neha / Jonas — forwarding...

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 16 Apr 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick: Short testimonial — recommendation to postpone

+1 to Neha's recommendation. From a GTM perspective, publishing a customer story while the customer is still handling an internal postmortem (and given a slight uptick in renewal risk indicators) could be perceived as tone-deaf. I'd like leadership sign-off to postpone and a simple script for the customer-facing reply.

Proposed script for reply to Peregrine: "Thanks — we love working with Peregrine. To ensure we represent results accurately and allow your team to complete their postmortem, we suggest we hold publication for two weeks and share a redlined draft for your review. Would that timeline work?"

Jonas
Head of Growth, Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick: Short testimonial — recommendation to postpone

Thanks all — I approve postponement. Neha, please prepare the redlined testimonial and the short customer reply script Jonas suggested. Marissa, hold the PDF from publishing and remove any hard percentage claims from the headline.

Action items:
- Neha: redline and draft the reply to Peregrine legal (due: Tue 2026-04-20)
- Marissa: update the marketing draft and remove percentages from headline (due: Tue 2026-04-20)
- Jonas: prepare a short comms note for the growth channel announcing the delay (due: Wed 2026-04-21)

I'll send an OK to the customer once Neha approves the final redline.

-Vivek
VP, Business Development
Redwood Inference
